site_path.description: Complete site path from Site Manager (e.g., '0/foo/bar/sl\\ash'). Required for -c option.

local_path.description: Path to set as local site. Required for -a option.

url.description: FTP URL to connect to (e.g., 'ftp://example.com/path'). Required for URL mode.

logontype.description: Login type, either 'ask' or 'interactive'. Only valid with -l and a URL.

start_site_manager.description: If true, starts FileZilla with Site Manager opened (-s).
